text: Planning a trip can be just as exciting as the journey itself. You research destinations, book flights, and make lists of places to see, imagining the adventures ahead. Once you arrive, however, you are immersed in new cultures that challenge your perspective. Sampling unfamiliar food is a highlight, though sometimes you end up with a dish you cannot name but will never forget. Language barriers often create funny moments, where gestures and smiles do the talking. In the end, it is these imperfect, unplanned experiences that become your most treasured memories, making every effort worthwhile.
